lifecycleObserved.meaning: Task restore rejects lower generations and restores task state; this is not ontology draft restoration.

Task events reject lower generation and same-generation wrong project connection; connection increments local epoch and marks uncertainty, clears progress/summaries, restored/task events follow generation/project/stateVersion guards. Cleanup unsubscribes existing Jobs.
Result summary reads check generation after awaits; engine health additionally checks generation plus connection epoch. These scoped guards do not prove a future ontology proof lifecycle.
ModelPanel is keyed by current projectId; changed model context/privacy/config/selections clears model preview/grant.
Model selection invalidates model preview/grant before requesting new result/field selection.
Model send confirmation and cancellation are scoped to context/preview/grant/invocation; cancellation can stop local waiting, cannot retract content already sent.

ontologyLifecycleRequestedNotImplemented: Bind complete trusted current source/project/public-internal identity/revision/vector/metadata and all supports before generating the real T02 Preview.
T01 original preview/full Diff/confirmation/Job/commit must revalidate exact sourceBinding, planRef and previewHash; renderer confirmed=true is not authority.
Project/session change, late reply, cancelled draft and old cursor/preview must not supply current write authority. T02 revision change preserves draft input and disables stale preview.
Queued/running cancellation and response-loss recovery use original operation/receipt reconciliation; no automatic replay, confirmation or new Job from UI restoration.
These are fixed T02 plan requirements, not I06 implemented production assertions.
